programs.title: The Iron Claw
programs.desc: The true story of the Von Erich brothers, who, through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, seek epic immortality on the biggest stage in sports.

programs.title: Good Boy
programs.desc: A man moves into a new home that has supernatural forces lurking in the shadows. As dark entities start to threaten him, his brave dog comes to the rescue.

programs.title: Solemates
programs.desc: A love triangle between a shoe store owner, a customer and an old pair of shoes. When Andrew walks into William's store to replace his own worn old pair of brogues, interest is piqued.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: Davis tries to get Brent to join his rugby team; Brent's more focused on inventing a new rugby chant; Hank and Karen convince Lacey to start selling pizza in the Ruby.

programs.title: Corner Gas Animated
programs.desc: The band Thunderface reunites; a song Brent wrote back in high school has Lacey investigating his mystery crush; Oscar shoots a fundraising video for the Seniors' Center.

programs.title: Transplant
programs.desc: Recovering from a personal crisis, Mags worries about how to get her life back on track; Bash takes an unorthodox approach to treating a soldier with PTSD; Theo treats a terminally ill child whose father is desperate for a drug trial.

programs.title: Mistletoe Time Machine
programs.desc: Three ex-best friends are forced back together when a magical incident sends them back to a pivotal moment in their shared past.

programs.title: 200% Wolf
programs.desc: Freddy Lupin's wayward wish transforms him into a werewolf and brings a mischievous moon spirit to Earth. With help from his friends and a legendary villain, he must restore cosmic order before the Earth and moon collide.

programs.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
programs.desc: After years of being sheltered from the human world, the Turtle brothers set out to win the hearts of New Yorkers and be accepted as normal teenagers. Their new friend, April O'Neil, helps them take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them.

programs.title: Eleanor the Great
programs.desc: After the death of her oldest friend, 94-year-old Eleanor Morgenstein moves from Florida to New York City for a fresh start. Wandering into a support group for Holocaust survivors, she tells a tale that takes on a dangerous life of its own.

programs.title: Air Bud: Golden Receiver
programs.desc: Teenager Josh (Kevin Zegers) just became the legal owner of his basketball-playing dog, Buddy. But now Buddy is playing football, too, thanks to veterinarian Patrick Sullivan (Gregory Harrison), who happens to be the new boyfriend of Josh's mom. Unfortunately, Josh and Patrick don't get along too well. But, when a couple of Russians (Nora Dunn, Perry Anzilotti) see Buddy playing on TV and decide to kidnap him for their circus, the two must band together to find the dog and save him.
